articles.summary: Boca Raton, FL December 30, 2024 - NewtekOne, Inc. (“the Company”) (NASDAQ: NEWT) and Paltalk, Inc. (“Paltalk”) (Nasdaq: PALT) will host a conference call on January 2, 2025, to discuss the anticipated January 2, 2025 closing of Paltalk’s acquisition...
articles.title: NewtekOne, Inc. and Paltalk, Inc. To Hold Conference Call on January 2, 2025, To Discuss the Anticipated January 2, 2025 Closing of the Divestiture of Newtek Technology Solutions, Inc. to Paltalk, Inc.
